name: AniWorld & Anime Downloader
description: Search, browse, and download anime and series from AniWorld, SerienStream (s.to), and Gogoanime directly within Jellyfin. Supports German Dub, English Sub, and English Dub options without language restrictions.
overview: Download anime and series from AniWorld, s.to, and Gogoanime directly within Jellyfin

versions.changelog:
v1.8.0.0 (Unlocked English Dub/Sub + Gogoanime Provider):
- Unlocked English Dub and English Sub: German-only restrictions completely removed across UI and backend
- Global Preferred Language selector: Select English Dub to download English Dub everywhere
- Integrated active Gogoanime streaming provider specialized in English Dub and Sub content
- Full MegaPlay stream resolution and decryption pipeline
- Clear error messaging when a requested language is not hosted on AniWorld
- Compatible with Jellyfin 10.9, 10.10, and 10.11 (Linux/Docker)
